summary: The implementation successfully addresses all 10 requirements from the BuildRequest. Backend data models for Properties, Projects, Tasks, and Team Members are implemented with all specified fields. Frontend pages for Properties, Projects, Tasks, and Team are present with filtering, CRUD operations, and visual components. Navigation system is implemented with route-based page switching. Professional visual theme uses a cohesive design system with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management system with ProfileSetupModal and UserProfile type
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify any user profile functionality, profile setup modal, or user profile data model. The backend includes UserProfile type and related functions (getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) which were not requested.
BuildRequest specifies a professional visual theme but does not request dark mode or theme switching functionality. ThemeProvider with next-themes suggests dark mode support.

hallucinated_features.description: HeroSection component with hero background gradient
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest lists hero-background.dim_1920x600.png as a required image but does not specify creating a hero section component. The implementation uses a gradient overlay instead of the requested image.

hallucinated_features.description: Authorization and access control system with admin/user permissions
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify role-based access control, admin permissions, or authorization system. The backend implements MixinAuthorization and AccessControl with permission checks.
